Every one of the five bar-level findings across both frozen v1 REJECTs is repaired, and each repair verifies against the primary source it depends on rather than against the artifact's own framing - the D-002 sentence against COORD's bytes, the file-02 inventory against file 02's bytes, and the G08 slice-1 claim against D-002's own required-gate set. Both Claude advisories are folded as well, leaving notFoldedThisSuccessor empty and that emptiness true.

repairAudit.finding: CLAUDE-V1-B1 / SUR-V1-B1 (both blockers, same defect) - the mandatory file-02 updates-inventory limb of D-002's two-part DR-110 MUST was absent, and the artifact's own quotation of the requirement stopped exactly at the conjunction
repairAudit.result: VERIFIED-REPAIRED on both halves the findings demanded
evidence: I confirmed the two blockers are one defect by reading both in full rather than inferring it from the single claimed repair. Claude B-1 locates the truncation at governingSources[2].role against COORD lines 448-451; Codex SUR-V1-B1 states the same limb is 'absent' across every section. Same requirement, same missing half.

The quotation half is repaired and I checked it against COORD's bytes, not against the artifact's claim. d002DispositionTextCarriedVerbatim pins COORD at 5fbd89eb..., which reproduces live, and carries lines 448-451 as four lines that match the source with zero mismatches. The restored text runs to 'and address file 02's unexercised "updates" inventory entry (turn-3 observation).' - the exact clause B-1 said was cut off.

The treatment half is repaired. updatesInventoryTextCarriedVerbatim pins file 02 at 1811c682..., which reproduces live, and carries lines 23-25 exactly, three for three, containing the 'updates' entry. updatesInventoryStanding then states the scoped disposition Codex required: the entry is unexercised in slice 1 because D-002 makes slice-1 install a fresh signed download, later-slice self-update/repair is what would exercise it, the candidate records that remainder, and it neither invents the update mechanism nor SATISFIES DR-110.

Codex's requiredRepair added three prohibitions alongside the repair - preserve the no-API boundary, and claim no owner recording, no SATISFIED standing, no D-096 (A) grant. All hold: whatThisDoesNotDo carries 'Does not invent a repair-media, download, or rollback API' and 'Does not mint a D-096 (A) grant', and sliceStanding.ownerDisposition records the owner disposition as still unrecorded.

repairAudit.finding: CLAUDE-V1-S1 - ID-DEP-U3 placed DR-G08 in the 'Not slice-1-required' set while D-002 puts G08 in the slice-1 required-gate set
repairAudit.result: VERIFIED-REPAIRED, and correct against D-002 rather than merely reworded
evidence: ID-DEP-U3 now reads 'DR-G08 is slice-1-required scoped to install trust (repair-media/rollback surfaces defer with this row). DR-G06 and DR-G11 are not slice-1-required.'

Because this repair flips a factual claim, I verified it against D-002's own bytes instead of accepting that a reviewer had asked for it. COORD's condition-4 required-gate set reads 'DR-G01..G05, G07, G08 (SCOPED to the trust surfaces the slice ships - root/index/core/component install trust; the repair-media/rollback surfaces defer with DR-110, named per turn-1 SF), G09 (scoped) ...' and separately 'G06/G11: NOT slice-1-required'. v2's sentence is a faithful compression of that, including the nuance that the repair-media and rollback surfaces defer with DR-110, which is this row.

repairAudit.finding: SUR-V1-S1 - sliceStanding conflated D-002's adopted product-scope choice with a recorded owner disposition
evidence: sliceStanding is restructured from the two v1 keys into three that separate the two things the finding said were conflated: d002ProductScope names the adopted slice-1 deferral as 'a product-scope choice'; ownerDisposition states 'The separate DR-110 owner disposition remains not recorded and is blocked on its lawful owner/grant path. D-096 (A) is unsatisfied. Zero SATISFIED / readiness effect.'; doesNotSatisfy states that recording the product-scope choice 'does not SATISFY DR-110 and is not a D-096 (A) grant.'

This resolves the dispatch's otherwise ambiguous repair label 'owner disposition unrecorded': the repair is to record explicitly that the owner disposition is unrecorded, rather than to leave the product-scope choice standing in for it.

repairAudit.finding: SUR-V1-S2 - self-update/repair crash injection was not explicitly routed once the rollback mechanisms were separated
evidence: A new ID-DEP-U4 names the surface - crash injection across self-update/repair journal write, fsync, rename, pointer, and the applicable prepare/commit/abort/no-return boundaries - and routes it to 'A later-slice harness in the DR-G18 class family, owned with this row. Not authored. Not QUALIFIED.'

It also carries the non-reuse caveat that makes the routing safe: 'Sharing a crash-harness class with DR-107 does not reuse DR-107's generation-rollback mechanism.' The ride is named without claiming authorship or QUALIFIED standing.

ADV-1 asked that COORD stop being summarized in prose while files 04 and 08 were carried verbatim; d002DispositionTextCarriedVerbatim now makes the governing sentence a verbatim carry with a reproducing pin.

ADV-2 objected that reMeasurementAtV1 called itself 'the only this-generation live COORD claim' while governingSources carried a second identical one. v2 removes governingSources[2].standing = LIVE, demotes reMeasurementAtV1 to HISTORICAL-AT-V1 with the note that the live digest is whichever block carries standing LIVE, and adds reMeasurementAtV2 as the sole LIVE block. I checked the invariant directly: exactly one block in the artifact carries standing LIVE.
Consequently notFoldedThisSuccessor is empty, and I verified that emptiness is true rather than asserted - all seven v1 items appear in honestyRepairsFromV1.

advisories.title: /updatesInventoryStanding is new in v2 and named by honestyRepairsFromV1 but not by basedOn.method's closed roster, so the roster's universal closure sentence is literally false of one path
advisories.detail: basedOn.method lists fourteen rostered paths and closes with 'Every path neither the roster nor succession metadata names is unchanged from v1.' /updatesInventoryStanding did not exist in v1, is not on that list, and is not succession metadata - it is substantive content, the disposition discharging half of an adopted D-002 MUST. Read strictly against that sentence alone, it is an undeclared change. The pattern reads as an omission rather than concealment: the two sibling blocks created by the same repair, /updatesInventoryTextCarriedVerbatim and /d002DispositionTextCarriedVerbatim, are both rostered, and this third one was missed.
advisories.whyNotAFinding: The artifact's own review contract defines the silent-path test as two-source. reviewGuidance[7] reads 'Attack any silent v1-to-v2 path outside basedOn.method / honestyRepairsFromV1', which is the standard formulation across this corpus, and honestyRepairsFromV1 names the block explicitly - 'updatesInventoryStanding names the remainder'. So the change is declared in one of the two locations a reviewer is told to read, nothing is concealed, and a reviewer following the stated contract misses nothing. I reserve SHOULD-FIX for cases where something is lost or left unresolvable; here the content is present, correct, and disclosed, and adopting these bytes would leave nothing wrong or unrecoverable.
advisories.suggestedFix: Add /updatesInventoryStanding to the roster in a successor, or widen the closure sentence's exemption to match reviewGuidance[7] by reading 'neither the roster, succession metadata, nor honestyRepairsFromV<n> names'. The second closes the class rather than the instance, and would keep the two sentences from drifting apart again.

whatIsSoundInV2: Every repair is anchored to a primary source with a reproducing pin rather than to prose. The D-002 requirement that was truncated is now a verbatim carry whose pin equals the LIVE remeasurement's COORD digest, so the quotation and the liveness claim cannot drift apart silently.

The G08 repair is the kind that is easy to get wrong by simply inverting the disputed sentence. It instead reproduces D-002's actual scoping - slice-1-required for install trust, with repair-media and rollback surfaces deferring with DR-110 - which is the distinction that makes the row's own deferral coherent.

basedOn.method carries a general standing rule, that whenever a new remeasurement block is added the prior LIVE block is rostered because it is demoted. That closes the ADV-2 class rather than the instance.
notFoldedThisSuccessor is empty and the emptiness is true: all seven v1 items, including both advisories, are folded and enumerated.
limitsOfThisReview: I did not read the other current v2 reviewer's file.
I did not re-adjudicate the v1 findings' severities; both reviewers' gradings are frozen and I verified only that each is repaired.
I did not execute any harness. DR-G08, DR-G18 and the later-slice crash-injection harness are named and not authored; nothing here is run evidence.
I did not evaluate DR-112 signed-index semantics or DR-107/G18 generation-rollback mechanics on their merits. I confirmed only that the artifact rides them by name and does not design them.
I did not invent or evaluate a repair-media API, and the artifact does not propose one.

ACCEPT is that these bytes are internally sound and that all five bar-level findings are repaired. It is NOT a statement that DR-110 is discharged: the row stays OPEN, the owner disposition remains unrecorded and blocked on its lawful owner/grant path, D-096 (A) is unsatisfied, the update mechanism is not designed, and the artifact remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED binding NOTHING.
summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Both v1 blockers are the same defect - D-002's two-part MUST with the file-02 updates-inventory limb absent and the requirement quoted only up to the conjunction - and both halves are repaired: the D-002 sentence is now carried verbatim through the second limb against a COORD pin that reproduces, file 02 lines 23-25 are carried exactly, and updatesInventoryStanding states the slice-1-versus-later disposition without inventing a mechanism. The three SHOULD-FIX are repaired too, with the G08 flip verified against D-002's own required-gate set rather than taken on the reviewer's word, and both Claude advisories are folded so notFoldedThisSuccessor is empty and true. One non-blocking advisory records that /updatesInventoryStanding is named by honestyRepairsFromV1 but missing from basedOn.method's roster, which leaves that sentence's universal literally false while concealing nothing.
